CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid templates maintained by Nackophilz, mostly for the French-speaking self-hosting community: Enable Actual (bank import for Actual Budget), FanKarr (Fankai download manager), Freebox OS Ultra Dashboard, Fluidd, gPhotos2Immich, JOAL and Unraid MCP. Templates are kept in sync with each upstream project. For template issues (wrong path, missing variable, broken WebUI link), open an issue on this repository; for application bugs, use the upstream project linked in each template.
